paragraphs.text: The Crescendo is the yearly New Year festivity of New Capenna organized by the Cabaretti .

During the events of the Adversary War in 4562 AR, the Crescendo was organized by Jinnie Myra , the adopted daughter of Jetmir , the boss of the Cabaretti. At that year's event, the Cabaretti revealed that Giada was "the Font," a new source of Halo . At the same time, the Adversary activated his agents across the city, ordering them to kill everyone in attendance at the event.
